Quickstart Guide

Your first API call in 5 minutes

Prerequisites

  • Node.js 18+ installed
  • Vedika API key (manage your key)
  • Basic JavaScript/TypeScript knowledge
1

Install the SDK

npm install @vedika-io/sdk
2

Initialize the Client

const { VedikaClient, VedikaAPIError } = require('@vedika-io/sdk');

try {
  const vedika = new VedikaClient({
    apiKey: process.env.VEDIKA_API_KEY
  });
  console.log('Client constructed locally; key validity is not checked.');
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof VedikaAPIError) {
    console.error(error.message, error.statusCode);
  } else {
    console.error(error.message);
  }
  process.exitCode = 1;
}

The V1 chart call returns { chartData: { data: ... }, metadata: ... }. Keep the complete response; do not flatten billing metadata. The current SDK chart declaration is broader than this wire contract.

3

Make Your First Call

Let's get a birth chart for someone born on May 15, 1990 in New Delhi:

async function readBirthChart(vedika) {
  const result = await vedika.getBirthChart({
    datetime: '1990-05-15T10:30:00+05:30',
    latitude: 28.6139,
    longitude: 77.2090,
    timezone: '+05:30'
  });

  const chart = result.chartData.data;
  console.log('Ascendant:', chart.ascendant);
  console.log('Metadata:', result.metadata);
  for (const planet of chart.planets) {
    console.log(planet.name + ': ' + planet.sign + ', longitude ' + planet.degree);
  }
  return result;
}

Complete Working Example

// quickstart.cjs
const { VedikaClient } = require('@vedika-io/sdk');

async function main() {
  // Initialize client
  const vedika = new VedikaClient({
    apiKey: process.env.VEDIKA_API_KEY
  });

  // Birth details
  const birthDetails = {
    datetime: '1990-05-15T10:30:00+05:30',
    latitude: 28.6139,
    longitude: 77.2090,
    timezone: 'Asia/Kolkata'
  };

  try {
    // 1. Get Birth Chart
    console.log('Fetching birth chart...');
    const chart = await vedika.getBirthChart(birthDetails);
    console.log('Birth Chart:', {
      ascendant: chart.chartData.data.ascendant,
      metadata: chart.metadata
    });

    // 2. Get Today's Panchang
    console.log('\nFetching today\'s panchang...');
    const panchang = await vedika.getPanchang({
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      latitude: 28.6139,
      longitude: 77.2090
    });
    console.log('Panchang:', panchang);

    // 3. Get Dasha Periods
    console.log('\nFetching dasha periods...');
    const dasha = await vedika.getDashas(birthDetails);
    console.log('Dasha periods:', dasha);

    // 4. AI-Powered Question
    console.log('\nAsking AI about career...');
    const response = await vedika.askQuestion({
      question: 'What are the career prospects for this person?',
      birthDetails
    });
    console.log('Response:', response.response);

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error:', error.message);
  }
}

main();

Run the Example

# VEDIKA_API_KEY must already be securely configured for this server.
export VEDIKA_API_KEY
node quickstart.cjs

Illustrative structure only; values come from your actual response.

Fetching birth chart...

Birth Chart: { ascendant: { ... }, metadata: { ... } }

 

Fetching today's panchang...

Panchang: { ...returned envelope... }

 

Fetching dasha periods...

Dasha periods: { ...returned data... }

 

Asking AI about career...

Response: <returned response>

getDashas() Calculate Vimshottari Dasha periods $0.03

askQuestion() AI-powered astrology questions $0.01-0.05
